items.question: What should be meditated upon after burning?
premises: The burnt offering is to be contemplated.
items.inference: The practitioner should meditate on the burnt offering.
uncertainties: The exact object of meditation is not specified in this two-word verse.
items.plain_english: One should meditate on the burnt offering.
